name: Acceptance: papier consideration
request:
Write exactly 1 email.

Write exactly one consideration email in English for the selected audience. The reader already knows Papier but has not bought. Explain one useful supported aspect of the offering and give a documented next step. Do not invent prior visits, conversations, discounts, urgency or results.

Tone of voice: Professional and polished - confident and credible, no slang or hype.
audience_segment: A goal-driven professional starting a focused 16-week push and wanting planning away from screens
